events.factual_description: High Zero's 28th annual Festival of Experimental Improvised Music runs September 24–27, 2026 at Theatre Project in Baltimore. Doors open at 7:30 PM and performances start at 8:30 PM each night. Each night presents one solo performance plus four group sets drawn from a changing roster of Baltimore and visiting improvisers; Saturday is the festival's Night of Randomization, with sixteen performers divided by chance into four sets.

en.why_it_matters: High Zero makes the improvisational premise itself the event: Baltimore and visiting musicians are placed into unrehearsed combinations where cello, strings, winds, percussion, voice, computers, homemade instruments and generative visuals have to negotiate the music in real time. Saturday pushes that logic furthest by assigning sixteen performers to four sets by chance, turning instrumental identity and risk into the actual form of the night.
en.trip_verdict: From the DMV, make room for one Baltimore night. Saturday is the clearest expression of the festival's random-collision premise; the four-night pass makes more sense only if following the changing combinations is itself the reason for the short trip.

es.why_it_matters: En High Zero la improvisación no adorna el cartel: es la estructura del festival. Músicos de Baltimore y visitantes entran en combinaciones sin ensayo donde cello, cuerdas, alientos, percusión, voz, computadoras, instrumentos construidos y visuales generativos tienen que resolver la música en tiempo real. El sábado lleva esa lógica al extremo al repartir por azar a dieciséis intérpretes en cuatro sets: la identidad instrumental y el riesgo son la forma misma de la noche.
es.trip_verdict: Desde el DMV, hazle espacio a una noche en Baltimore. El sábado concentra mejor la lógica de colisiones aleatorias del festival; el pase de cuatro noches sólo cobra sentido si seguir cómo cambian las combinaciones es parte central de la escapada.
